scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uvicorn app.main:app --reload || echo 'Backend not set up yet'
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt || echo 'Backend not set up yet'
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && pytest || echo 'Backend not set up yet'
scripts.deploy: ./scripts/deploy/deploy-all.sh || echo 'Deploy scripts not set up yet'
